original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚乔斯一司机因背信罪被判六个月监禁
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚乔斯地方法院周三判处26岁司机卡比鲁·哈鲁纳六个月监禁，罪名是背信。该司机当庭认罪，法院判处其六个月监禁，可选择缴纳5万奈拉罚金，并须向原告赔偿17万奈拉。据检方称，被告将原告介绍给一名购车者，后者向被告账户转入67万奈拉，但被告未经同意擅自取走22万奈拉。

key_facts.fact: 乔斯地方法院判处26岁司机卡比鲁·哈鲁纳六个月监禁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A Jos Magistrate’s Court on Wednesday sentenced a 26-year-old driver, Kabiru Haruna to six months in prison for breach of trust.

key_facts.fact: 被告当庭认罪，法院判处六个月监禁并可选择缴纳5万奈拉罚金
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The convict pleaded guilty to the charge brought against him by the police. The Magistrate, Mrs Irene Pati sentenced the convict to six months in prison with an option of N50,000 fine.

key_facts.fact: 法院命令被告向原告赔偿17万奈拉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: She also ordered him to pay a compensation of N170,000 to the complainant.

key_facts.fact: 检方称被告将原告介绍给购车者，后者转入67万奈拉，被告擅自取走22万奈拉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the now-convicted Haruna linked the complainant with a prospective car buyer, who paid N670,000 into the convict’s account, but he fraudulently withdrew N220,000 without consent.

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源（尼日利亚通讯社），尚缺乏交叉验证
